description: One single full-body character for the SAME grounded modern supernatural investigation headquarters game as the style reference. Full head and shoes visible, 6px minimum top/bottom margin, target body height230-240px on128x256. Match reference precise native pixel density, selective dark outlines, controlled pixel shading and subdued interior lighting. Keep THIS character own hair, iris and clothing colors. Crisp native1px clusters, no antialiasing, transparent background, no floor or shadow, no text, no weapons or held props, one character only.
